observations: A bicycle stands on dirt ground with its kickstand down.
The frame is silver or grey with black tires and a black saddle.
No brand, model, or serial text is readable on the frame in the photo.
Background shows a building with red and white railings and utility poles under an overcast sky.

claims.claim: Buy and drive nothing to fix
claims.evidence: A single static photo cannot show brakes, gears, tires holding air, or frame integrity.

risks.risk: Frame has hidden cracks or weld failure
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full frame, especially joints and welds
Video of the brakes being applied while the bike is pushed

risks.risk: Gears or chain are broken or stiff
risks.proof: Video of pedaling and shifting through all gears

risks.risk: Tires do not hold air or wheels are bent
risks.proof: Close-up of tires and a video of wheels spinning straight

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the bicycle frame for cracks
Video of pedaling and gear shifting
Close-up of tires and wheels spinning
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a bicycle by type, so it can be priced at worst-case non-working condition even though the seller's 'nothing to fix' claim cannot be verified remotely.
